## Checklist
- [ ] `pwsh tools/apworld-test.ps1` passes (or the World workflow is green)
- [ ] Generated a seed with the packed `ootxmm.apworld`, or explained why not
- [ ] `ROADMAP.md` updated: row added for work started, row deleted for work finished
- [ ] `DEVELOPMENT.md` updated if layout, tooling or conventions changed; new world files added to `tools/build_apworld.py`
- [ ] Metadata regenerated with `raw/GenerateMetadata.py` if OoTMM data changed, with the OoTMM commit noted
